findings.confidence: raw receipts, original reader and retained SQLite agree
findings.finding: Both native original diagnostics exit zero because they assert safety/accounting only; original reader correctly rejects finite_target_met=false. Both fresh tests actually execute and exit 101 at the explicit four-second/six-depth assertion; FRESH_NATIVE_PROCESS_REQUIRED is a wrapper first-failure label, not a missing execution.

All four pressure scenarios acknowledge seven honest packets, receiver active height is seven. Head independent clients admit no non-genesis packet; prospective-merge clients durably admit heights one and two, but all four independent active tips remain genesis because only complete final page activates the requested tip. All four confirm zero transactions.
All four attack-free baselines complete independent depth six in the same fixed four-second window; confirmation means probabilistic depth/work, never finality or execution authority.

findings.confidence: original meter and nested CPU accounting
findings.finding: All phases start with two-second mutation credit and end with approximately two-second credit, zero CPU budget refusals and zero accounting failures. Endpoints do not prove the credit never dipped in between. Parent cgroup is 0.25 CPU shared by receiver and every client; whole-wrapper CPU counters show throttling, but there is no per-phase kernel sample to attribute exact CPU loss.

findings.confidence: source-established call topology; cost share not measured
findings.finding: history_import::admit_packet intentionally supplies control.check to every history_checkpoint, and scalar_cpu::observe_with_control invokes it before CPU observation and throughout refill. Thus every W1 callback physically verifies the Host. An additional sparse history_kernel_work_checkpoint branch verifies the Host again at 30 of 1099 actual callbacks per retained legal proof. The 1099 guards are the current resource/revocation contract, not a proved bug; deleting them would change that contract. The sparse-selector unit test alone is not an end-to-end count. No per-stage native trace identifies how much of failure those checks cause.

Both fixtures create PublicServer::new with arithmetic_facts=None and rejection_cache=None. Public Submit and independent History both call WorkCheckedPacket::verify_with_progress then the default pon_work::verify_with_progress. A FullLimb default change covers both; ArithmeticFactCache fixed Transposed is unused in these experiments.

findings.confidence: native binary and named test process evidence
findings.finding: The service build succeeds and both named service tests execute for each lane. Their failures are actual business deadline failures and are independent of the other jobs initial cargo fmt failure.

next_discriminating_checks: Rerun identical four-second, sixteen-worker fixtures after the isolated FullLimb default switch; retain all failed receipts and exact before/after source and kernel identity.

If additional instrumentation is authorized, separately record independent History per-page decode, W1, Host-check, M06 admission, activation, and SQLite commit CPU/wall under the same budget. Preserve all 1099 boundary guards and refill controls.

Instrument actual Host verifier invocation counts inside history_checkpoint and the sparse branch, including cancellation/resource-change tests; do not infer integrated cadence solely from the helper predicate test.

Any Host-read implementation optimization must preserve current boot ID, parent inode/ownership, actual calling thread cgroup membership, all five physical limit reads, deadline/refill semantics, and error propagation; do not increase the resource budget.

source_locations.purpose: The process-exit guard precedes report validation; fresh exit 101 yields FRESH_NATIVE_PROCESS_REQUIRED.
The original diagnostic exit zero cannot pass a false finite_target_met report.
Seven ACKs precede History import; one original deadline is passed to every page; no post-pressure import credit.
The explicit business target assert is the actual panic.
Every native progress checkpoint retains Host and CPU controls; only a complete final page activates the requested tip.
Resource closure runs before CPU observation and again during refill waits.
Sparse branch adds a second physical Host check at selected points; unit test counts predicate matches, not integrated calls.
Every verify reopens actual boot/cgroup/five limits and checks original parent identity.
Fixture has no arithmetic or negative cache; plain callback verifier selected.
Both receiver and History reach the default primitive.
